title: The 4% Rule Is Broken — Retire $250K Short
hook: The rule everyone uses to plan retirement was calculated in 1994 — and the financial planner who created it now says it's dangerously wrong.
angle: The 4% safe withdrawal rate was built on 1994 bond yields of 6-7%; today's lower yields and decade-longer lifespans mean 3.3% is the new safe rate, leaving a $210K gap in most retirement plans
audience: Anyone age 30-60 planning retirement, especially those using online retirement calculators
key_numbers: 4% rule created in 1994 by Bill Bengen
Updated safe rate: 3.3% based on current conditions
$210,000 gap most calculators never show you
~32% failure rate at 4% over a 35-year retirement
